title: Commissioners want to restore funding to some county departments | News | swoknews.com
text:
Comanche County Commissioners want to restore some funding to four county departments making plans for the new fiscal year.
Commissioners approved the action Tuesday, as they discussed the Estimate of Needs for Fiscal Year 2025-2026, the document that sets budgets for county offices for the coming fiscal year. The board ultimately decided to table any action until budget figures could be adjusted before voting them into place.
